detail: UK votes to leave the EU.
Transition period begins; EU rules still apply.

GB becomes a third country for EU SPS rules. Chilled minced-meat preparations such as fresh sausages can no longer go from GB to the EU. NI Protocol applies; a grace period covers chilled meats moving GB to NI.
UK and EU agree to extend the chilled-meats grace period for GB to NI.
Retail goods, including sausages, can move GB to NI under the NI Retail Movement Scheme with "Not for EU" labelling.
Common Understanding: work towards an SPS agreement with dynamic alignment.
SPS agreement expected; reported to lift bans on products such as fresh sausages. Target start mid-2027.
